moments.title: European Athletics Championships begin
moments.blurb: Birmingham hosts the European Athletics Championships for the first time, with 7 days of world-class track and field action at Alexander Stadium from August 10-16.

angles.name: Main Event Kick-off
angles.copy: Europe's best athletes descend on Birmingham! The European Athletics Championships kick off tomorrow for a week of incredible track & field. Who are you backing for gold? #EuroAthletics

angles.name: Birmingham Focus
angles.copy: Get ready, Birmingham! The Alexander Stadium is set for a week of world-class athletics as the European Championships begin tomorrow. Will you be there?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, will take place at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16.

angles.name: Football Season Curtain-Raiser
angles.copy: It's the traditional curtain-raiser! Arsenal v Man City for the Community Shield next Sunday. Where are you watching the first big game of the season?

angles.name: Cardiff Host City
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage next Sunday! The Principality Stadium hosts Arsenal vs Man City in the Community Shield. Who's heading to the capital?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for a record-extending 20th non-consecutive week (chart dated Aug 6-12).

angles.name: Chart Topper Reign
angles.copy: Still unstoppable! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes it 20 weeks at UK #1. Is it the song of the year?

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: Twenty weeks at the top! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are making history with 'Rein Me In'. What's your favourite lyric?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's 'Petal' new Top 5 entry
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande scores a brand new entry in the UK Top 5 this week with 'Petal', landing at number 4 on the Official Singles Chart.

angles.name: New Music Alert
angles.copy: New Ariana Grande alert! 'Petal' is a fresh entry in the UK Top 5. Have you heard it yet? What's the verdict?

angles.name: Chart Impact
angles.copy: She's done it again! Ariana Grande's 'Petal' blooms straight into the Top 5. Could it climb higher next week?

moments.title: UK braces for heatwave next week
moments.blurb: Heatwave conditions are expected to return across much of the UK next week, with temperatures potentially reaching 36°C in parts of East Anglia and south-east England by Thursday.

angles.name: Beat the Heat
angles.copy: Sun's out, shades on! A heatwave is officially on its way next week for much of the UK. How are you planning to stay cool?

angles.name: Temperature Talk
angles.copy: Temperatures soaring to 36°C in some parts next week! Get ready for sunshine, but remember to stay hydrated. #SummerVibes

moments.title: Roots Picnic London wraps up today
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival, making its international debut in London, concludes today at Crystal Palace Bowl after two days of blending music, culture, and community.

angles.name: Last Day Vibes
angles.copy: It's the final day of the first-ever Roots Picnic in London! If you're at Crystal Palace Bowl, soak up those last vibes. Who have you seen?

angles.name: Festival Farewell
angles.copy: The Roots Picnic wraps up today in London! What a weekend of music and culture. Did you catch any of the action?

moments.title: The Weeknd's 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour in London
moments.blurb: The Weeknd is expected to play a series of stadium shows in London around the middle of August as part of his extended 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour.

angles.name: Mega Star Alert
angles.copy: London, get ready! The Weeknd is bringing his massive 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour to the city around next weekend. Are you going?

angles.name: Stadium Spectacle
angles.copy: Seven stadium shows in London? The Weeknd is set to dominate the capital next week! What's your ultimate Abel Tesfaye track?

moments.title: Happy 26th Birthday, Arlo Parks!
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter and poet Arlo Parks, known for her Mercury Prize-winning album 'Collapsed in Sunbeams', turns 26 today, August 9.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Sending huge birthday wishes to the incredibly talented Arlo Parks, who turns 26 today! What's your favourite track from her?

angles.name: Mercury Prize Winner
angles.copy: Happy 26th Birthday to Mercury Prize winner Arlo Parks! Still loving 'Collapsed in Sunbeams'. What's her best song?

moments.title: Happy 75th Birthday, John Deacon!
moments.blurb: John Deacon, the legendary bassist and songwriter for Queen, turns 75 on August 19.

angles.name: Queen Legend
angles.copy: A huge happy 75th birthday to the iconic John Deacon, legendary bassist of Queen, on August 19! What's your favourite Queen track he wrote?

angles.name: Bassist Extraordinaire
angles.copy: Celebrating John Deacon's 75th birthday on the 19th! The quiet force behind so many Queen classics. Send him some love!

moments.title: Happy 81st Birthday, Ian Gillan!
moments.blurb: Ian Gillan, the powerful vocalist of rock legends Deep Purple, celebrates his 81st birthday on August 19.

angles.name: Rock Vocal Icon

angles.name: Deep Purple Legend
angles.copy: Happy 81st to the voice of 'Smoke on the Water'! Deep Purple's Ian Gillan celebrates his birthday on the 19th. Still rocking!

moments.title: Happy 67th Birthday, Kurtis Blow!
moments.blurb: American rapper and hip-hop pioneer Kurtis Blow, known for hits like 'The Breaks', turns 67 today, August 9.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Pioneer

angles.name: Birthday Groove
angles.copy: Celebrating the 67th birthday of Kurtis Blow today! Get down to some classic grooves from a hip-hop trailblazer. #HipHopHistory

moments.title: Summer School Holidays continue across UK
moments.blurb: Most schools in England and Wales are still enjoying their summer holidays, which typically run until early September, while Scottish schools resumed in mid-August.

angles.copy: Making the most of the last few weeks of summer holidays? Share your best family day out ideas!

moments.title: Drought conditions and water bans persist in England
moments.blurb: Drought conditions continue across England, with over 25 million people affected by Temporary Use Bans (hosepipe bans) as July was the driest on record for the country.

angles.name: Water Saving Tips
angles.copy: With drought conditions ongoing and water bans in place for millions, every drop counts. What are your top tips for saving water at home?

angles.name: Environmental Impact
angles.copy: Drought continues to affect England, impacting everything from farming to river levels. How is it affecting your area?
